svg.aria-label: The same 40 individuals, in 5 rows of 8, sampled four ways with n = 10. Simple random sample: any 10. Stratified: the rows are strata, 2 chosen at random from every row. Cluster: the columns are clusters, every individual in 2 randomly chosen columns. Systematic: numbered 1 to 40, random start 3, then every 4th.
svg.text: any 10 of the 40; every set of 10 equally likely
rows are strata: an SRS of 2 inside every row
columns are clusters: all of 2 random columns
numbered 1 to 40: random start 3, then every 4th
